title: Critiquing a Work of Art
grammar: Chaining adverbial participles with aesthetic and analytical modifiers
goal: I can build complex analytical sentences that chain adverbial participles (-va/-ve) with object and instrumental complements
I can avoid dangling participles by keeping the implied subject of -va/-ve aligned with the matrix subject
I can use B2 art-criticism vocabulary (kompozíció, szimbolika, hatás, kifejezőerő)
